# `debugging` — Debugging demo: CLI reference

> **Generated file — do not edit.** Rendered from the spec registry
> (`geneva_examples/examples/debugging/__init__.py`) by `geneva_examples/docs_gen/`;
> regenerate with `make docs`. The same text is shown by `uv run <command> --help`.
> Docs index: [`docs/README.md`](../../README.md).

Debugging demo — generate real per-row errors, then analyze them.

One step seeds a small table and backfills a deliberately faulty UDF with
``skip_on_error``: the job completes DONE while the failing rows are written
as NULLs and recorded in the ``geneva_errors`` system table. That leaves real
material to analyze in the TUI table viewer (``uv run tui`` -> Tables ->
``geneva_errors (system)``) or with ``uv run jobs show <job_id>``.

**Modality:** `demo` · **Steps in pipeline order:** [`demo-errors`](#demo-errors)

## Common options (every command)

Every command below is generated by `geneva_examples/core/spec.py` (`build_command`) and accepts these options in addition to its own:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | path | `None` | Path to config.yaml (default ./config.yaml). |
| `--mode` | choice: local \| enterprise | `local` | Connection mode: 'local' or 'enterprise'. |
| `--db-uri` | str | `None` | Override the config db_uri (enterprise mode). |
| `--log-level` | str | `INFO` | Logging level. |

A `None` default is resolved at runtime: `--mode` and `--db-uri` follow the config-file precedence, and some model steps resolve `--num-gpus None` to a per-step GPU fraction inside their `run()` (see the step's source file).

## `demo-errors`

**Generate debuggable errors**

Seed a small `(id, value)` table, then backfill a `score` column with a UDF that deterministically fails on some rows (divisible-by-N -> ValueError, ends-in-9 -> TimeoutError) under `skip_on_error`. The job finishes DONE with NULL holes and real `geneva_errors` records — then analyze them in the Tables viewer or with `uv run jobs show <job_id>`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Run | `uv run demo-errors [OPTIONS]` |
| GPU | no (CPU-only) |
| Prerequisite | none |
| Mode default | pinned to `--mode local` |
| Source | `geneva_examples/examples/debugging/seed_errors.py` (`run()`), spec in `geneva_examples/examples/debugging/__init__.py` |

In addition to the [common options](#common-options-every-command):

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `debug_demo` | Demo table to (over)write. |
| `--rows` | int ≥ 1 | `40` | Rows to seed (value == id). |
| `--fail-every` | int ≥ 0 | `7` | Values divisible by this raise ValueError (0 disables). |
| `--concurrency` | int ≥ 1 | `2` | Backfill concurrency. |
| `--task-size` | int ≥ 1 | `32` | Rows per read task. |
| `--checkpoint-size` | int ≥ 1 | `32` | Rows per UDF checkpoint. |
| `--backfill-timeout-min` | int ≥ 1 | `30` | Backfill timeout (min). |
| `--flush-interval-s` | float ≥ 0 | `5.0` | Checkpoint flush interval (s). |
| `--schema-wait-attempts` | int ≥ 1 | `30` | Schema-visibility attempts. |
| `--schema-wait-sleep-s` | int ≥ 0 | `2` | Seconds between checks. |
